info.title: Airline Management API
info.description: Migrated API for the AirlineManagement system (source: AirlineManagement_VBNetLegacy). This endpoint replaces the WinForms `ViewFlightForm.LoadFlight` routine.

tags.name: Flights
tags.description: Operations for managing and viewing flights

get.description: Retrieves the details of a single flight by its numeric identifier. Migrated from the legacy `ViewFlightForm.LoadFlight(flightId As Integer)` method, which calls `FlightRepository.GetById`. If no flight exists, the legacy code showed a 'Flight not found.' error and closed the form; this is represented as a 404 response. The legacy UI disabled the 'Book This Flight' action and displayed 'Sold Out' when `availableSeats` equals 0; clients should apply the same rule using the `availableSeats` field.

parameters.name: flightId
parameters.description: Unique numeric identifier of the flight (maps to the legacy `Flight.Id` / `flightId` Integer argument).

400.description: Invalid request. The `flightId` path parameter is not a valid 32-bit integer.

example.message: flightId must be a valid integer.

401.description: Unauthorized. Not applicable to the legacy code (no authentication check); reserved for the modernized gateway if authentication is added.

403.description: Forbidden. Not applicable to the legacy code (no authorization check).

404.description: Flight not found. Corresponds to the legacy branch where `FlightRepository.GetById` returns Nothing and the 'Flight not found.' error is shown.

500.description: Internal server error. Corresponds to unexpected database or data-access failures in `FlightRepository.GetById`.

Flight.description: Flight details, mapped from the legacy `Flight` model and the `FlightRepository.GetById` SELECT projection.

departureDate.description: Departure date (legacy `DepartureDate` DateTime, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd in the UI).

departureTime.description: Departure time of day (legacy `DepartureTime` TimeSpan, rendered as hh:mm in the UI).

arrivalTime.description: Arrival time of day (legacy `ArrivalTime` TimeSpan, rendered as hh:mm in the UI).

price.description: Ticket price (legacy `Price` Decimal, rendered with currency format 'C' in the UI).

availableSeats.description: Number of seats still available. When 0, the legacy UI disables booking and shows 'Sold Out'.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the flight record was created (legacy `CreatedAt` DateTime).
